purpose: Minimal fresh r2 of retained r1 zero-step CPU wall manufacture. Test normal-head pressure reconstruction with mixed normal/tangential gravity and periodic Z, without modifying production or any r1 evidence.
initialization: Reuse actual r1 CPU initialization with retained zero-g parallel FreeSlip wall seeds (Wendland original or prepared Cubic copy), 1024 soil +256 fixed native IDs, dp=1/512 and h/dp=1.8. No GenCase, resampling, public admission change or integrator.

manufacture.cases: sign=-1,0,+1 crossed with coincident and exact Dp/8 mirror offsets: six conditions.
manufacture.full_gravity: After actual zero-g initialization, Gravity=CSP.gravity=(sign,0,2). The retained walls are x-normal, so gn=(sign,0,0), gt=(0,0,2).
manufacture.pressure: p=128+rho_w*gn dot x, rho_w=1000; pressure is independent of periodic Z. J=1, theta=0, effective stress=0, zero saved physical/derivative/tangent velocities.
manufacture.finished_acceleration: Native Darcy-Ace=-gn. Since Ace=as-g, this is prescribed true tangential as=gt; it is not a mechanically static full-gravity equilibrium. Correct mirrored Q*(Ace+g)-g remains -gn.
manufacture.pure_tangent: sign=0 keeps full g=(0,0,2), constant pressure128 and native Ace=0. It must satisfy the SAME good wall state, actual-plane pressure/gradient/Ace/normal flux and independent complete-rate checks.

budgets: Unchanged r1 constants, arithmetic and original criteria. Condition uses actual J/kernel weights. td=32768*DBL_EPSILON*condition; tf=64*FLT_EPSILON*condition. Pressure/J/Ace bounds remain256tf/2td/tf. True gradient is rho_w*gn, expected fitted Ace=-gn. Flux bound uses k/gamma*(tf*(rho_w*|gn|+rho_w)+256td/h), NEVER |full g|; the extra tangential2 cannot widen any state/flux budget. Complete-rate bound remains (32*FLT_EPSILON+4096*DBL_EPSILON)*max(1,raw absolute-term rate).

negative_controls.eligible: Only sign!=0: 256 actual-plane probes, each evaluates both omitted-normal-head and wrong-Q*Ace counterfactuals with the unchanged >100-times-good-budget witness.
negative_controls.pure_tangent: Skip both negatives at all128 sign0 probes: both have no mathematical effect when gn=0. CSV negative flux cells are blank and negative_controls_evaluated=0; no zero-normal-g negative pass is claimed.
negative_controls.normal_head_counterfactual: The deliberately missing head uses p=128+rho_w*gn dot mirror_x, not full g dot x. This isolates the normal-head defect instead of injecting an unrelated periodic-Z pressure jump.

coverage: 6 cases,1536 native wall rows,384 true-plane rows,6144 complete-rate receiver rows,256 eligible negative probes and128 explicitly skipped probes;1280 original native identities. Eighteen field CSVs plus native_ids.csv and honest completion.json. Native physical18 and geometry/ID/normal invariants remain r1 checks.
execution: AUTHOR ONLY. No build/run/import/syntax check now. Root must full-read this fresh source/note before separately authorizing a new helper from the forthcoming upl_gravity_wall_r2 DebugCPU objects. Each eventual kernel execution requires a fresh output; no retry/overwrite.
limits: Private parallel-wall, constant-J/k, prescribed instantaneous acceleration component. No public normal-gravity admission, force-stage mechanical equilibrium, pressure-head trajectory, periodic full-g hydrostatics, evolving material, wall corner, integral time step, Cryer solver or physical acceptance.
